notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary object-publication and registration fence surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies publication and subscription prerequisites, whole-class unpublication and attribute unpublication boundaries, successful registration after republication, stable name and handle lookups, discovery, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary object publication, subscription, unpublication, registration, lookup, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery callbacks
